'''Roger Balian''' (born 18 January 1933) is a [[Armenians in France|French-Armenian]] physicist who has worked on [[quantum field theory]], [[quantum thermodynamics]], and [[theory of measurement]].<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://www.mth.kcl.ac.uk/~streater/balian.html |title = Department of Mathematics &#124; King's College London}}</ref>
Balian is a member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web |url= http://www.academie-sciences.fr/en/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-B/roger-balian.html |title= Roger Balian &#124; Liste des membres de l'Académie des sciences / B &#124; Listes par ordre alphabétique &#124; Listes des membres &#124; Membres &#124; Nous connaître}}</ref> His important works include the [[Balian-Low theorem]]. He teaches statistical physics at the [[École Polytechnique|École polytechnique]].<ref>[http://www.physique.polytechnique.edu/accueil/presentation/histoire/les-polytechniciens-en-physique-des-particules-et-en-physique-theorique/les-polytechniciens-en-physique-des-particules-et-en-physique-theorique-6493.kjsp?RH=ACCUEIL-FR Les polytechniciens en physique des particules et en physique théorique], École Polytechnique. {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120227134021/http://www.physique.polytechnique.edu/accueil/presentation/histoire/les-polytechniciens-en-physique-des-particules-et-en-physique-theorique/les-polytechniciens-en-physique-des-particules-et-en-physique-theorique-6493.kjsp?RH=ACCUEIL-FR |date=2012-02-27 }}</ref>
